myDAR walk dashboard

Source: R/mydar_views.R
mydar_dashboard.Rd

Lays out a walk the way the myDAR app's Results screen does: one map viewer first (mydar_cloud_view: 2D plan over the orthophoto or 3D cloud with the orthophoto draped on the DEM, with the track's uncertainty band, the profile line and the Shape / Map accuracy card), the profile below it, then the quality charts (map-position uncertainty, GPS residuals, point sigma, accuracy figures, terrain). In the viewer's 2D mode the Select tool picks points and the profile highlights the same ones. When the walk has GPS residuals, the GPS chart shares a time cursor with the uncertainty chart.

Usage

mydar_dashboard(walk, points = NULL, profile = NULL, width = 0.5)

Arguments

walk

A mydar_walk.

points

Draw the points, colored by class, over the orthophoto, small and translucent so the image shows through. Defaults to TRUE only when the walk has no orthophoto. Brushing the plan view selects these points, so turn them on to link it to a profile.

profile

Optional list(from = c(x, y), to = c(x, y)) for the profile line. Default: across the track at its midpoint.

width

Corridor width in meters; points within width / 2 of the line are kept.

Value

A browsable htmltools tag list. Print it, return it from a Shiny renderUI(), or save it with htmltools::save_html().

Examples

if (requireNamespace("htmltools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  mydar_dashboard(mydar_iphone_walk)
}
